carry_requires_all: both heads are commit objects in repo_path
exactly one merge-base for (approved.base_sha, approved.head) and for (proposed.base_sha, proposed.head)
raw diff bytes of merge-base..head under a pinned command are byte-identical and non-empty
git patch-id --stable of those bytes exists and is identical
same repository, pr_number and base_ref on both sides

proposed.base_sha is the actual fresh target PR base, the current tip of refs/heads/<base_ref> in repo_path; a supplied base off the base branch (side-commit base substitution, RCO2 via Lead 2026-11-09T07:25:55Z) refuses. approved.base_sha is the authenticated original reviewed base; no further ancestry rule is placed on it (Lead 2026-11-09T07:37:02Z)
identity authority is the canonical registry the existing verifier loads (configs/bridge_identity_registry.json); evidence.roster is caller data and never authority (Tools 07:36:27Z, Lead 07:38:08Z)
carried items are only actual non-author approvals; the receipt records build_author_slot_waivers (sorted author agents whose build slot is waived), the field name used by the existing verifier
original approvals satisfy the existing old-head identity and scope rules: lead and tools build_consensus plus a recognized RCO rco_pass that is not the PR author
carried approvals bind by structured original event reference; text mentioning both heads is never a second approval
no unretracted recognized-RCO veto at the approved head, the proposed head or the canonical task/PR scope; a clear counts only from the same RCO at the same head after the veto
every required CI check completed with success at the proposed head; the required list is non-empty
content_refusal_patterns_note: regexes over str(ValueError) taken from Tools e89f85b5 messages; Tools may repoint them, a refusal for any other reason (for example argument type) fails the test

entry_point_signatures.derive_content_identity: derive_content_identity(*, repo_root: pathlib.Path, old_base, old_head, new_base, new_head) -> proof dict; ValueError on refusal whose text matches content_refusal_patterns[expected class] (Tools e89f85b5 convention, adopted per Lead 07:27:50Z)
entry_point_signatures.evaluate: evaluate(evidence: dict) -> dict with carry (bool), reason (str), carried (list of dicts with agent, agent_uuid, kind, approved_head, event_sha256) and receipt (dict); a refusal reason matches gate_reason_patterns[expected reason class]
entry_point_signatures.verify_content_identity: verify_content_identity(*, proof, repo_root: pathlib.Path, old_base, old_head, new_base, new_head) -> re-derived proof; ValueError on refusal (Tools e89f85b5 convention)
entry_point_signatures.verify_receipt: verify_receipt(receipt: dict, evidence: dict) -> bool; recomputes merge-bases, raw diff bytes and patch-id from git at evidence.repo_path and the approvals, vetoes and CI from evidence; never trusts receipt booleans

evidence_fields.accepted_queue_complete: true only when the whole accepted queue was scanned
evidence_fields.approved: head, base_sha, base_ref, pr_number, repository of the head the approvals name
evidence_fields.ci: required (check names) and runs (head, name, status, conclusion)
evidence_fields.events: accepted queue events in canonical append order; list order decides precedence, ts_utc never does
evidence_fields.pr_author: agent that authored the PR; never satisfies the RCO slot
evidence_fields.proposed: head, base_sha, base_ref, pr_number, repository of the head to evaluate
evidence_fields.recognized_rco_agents: agents whose rco_pass fills the RCO slot and whose veto blocks
evidence_fields.repo_path: local git repository holding both heads and both base tips
evidence_fields.roster: caller-supplied agent name to agent_uuid; informational only, never identity authority
evidence_fields.task_id: canonical task id of the PR (branch name)
